controller.first_cause: Controller.primary_exception is set before any secondary failure event. The exact launcher exception object, original_error and original_observation are retained, with full original receipt prefix, observed totals, pending jobs and unresolved custody in failure_context.
controller.reserve: Before any process, require 2*launcher.records.entry_cap+1MiB logical byte reservation and8 file slots within original aggregate write/retained/file allowances. Initial immutable TERMINAL_HOLD.json must persist before admission. Ordinary writes and resource admission retain this reservation. This does not promise OS/disk success.
controller.canonical_outcome: A successfully written FINAL_DISPOSITION.json is admitted. On final writer failure it is explicitly unadmitted and may be partial; TERMINAL_HOLD_FINAL is a reserved incomplete record. If both writer paths fail, the original primary is raised with controller_terminal_disposition and controller_failure_context; the initial durable hold remains INCOMPLETE. No persisted complete result is invented.
controller.no_retry: run_started and terminal_stop prevent retry or further invocation. Partial/failing terminal writes do not release custody.
controller.all_storage_failure_limit: Full original observation/costs remain owned in the outward original exception and in-memory terminal disposition, with existing original journal files. Persistent physical storage failure may prevent new durable detail; the pre-existing hold is not relabelled a fully persisted closure.

leader_and_descendants.original_leader: wait4 preserves the original direct child exit/signal/CPU/RSS/IO and observation time. forced_wait_completed is true only when a kill was requested; natural waits are false.
leader_and_descendants.group_identity: Verify the selected PGID equals the direct child PID while the child is still unreaped. No group signal is sent after original wait or original-wait identity loss.
leader_and_descendants.quiescence: A separate killpg(signal0) ProcessLookupError establishes absence of the original group. A present/permission-denied/unknown group retains an unresolved hold. This is not a descendant wait, descendant CPU receipt, or qualification of arbitrary escaped-group actors.
leader_and_descendants.terminal_original_hold: Once original group containment is unresolved, later absence/cleanup cannot rewrite the original. External recovery requires separate explicit evidence/selection. No automatic recovery is implemented.
leader_and_descendants.admission: No stable output inventory or stream pins, custody release, or next invocation while any owned group/container/actor custody remains unresolved. Actual directories/streams remain retained for recovery; empty admitted inventory is not an observed zero extent.

sequence: same-host cgroup.events bounded read with frozen=1
native_container_composition.purpose: Whole cgroup freeze contains processes which changed groups before any copies; original group absence alone is not an arbitrary-descendant isolation claim.
native_container_composition.supervisor_cleanup: Separate /proc kill requests and host removal do not become original actor/descendant waits. An unresolved original actor/group receipt stays unadmitted.
native_container_composition.qualification: Actual Linux Docker/cgroup/isolation behavior is unexecuted and remains subject to the original29 gates.
